OCCUPATION: the attachment has NO Occupation/Employer column at all, so occupation is blank on every contribution row for the FIRST of the three reasons in the brief - the form has no such column - and each row note says so. DATES: the attachment prints no Date column on either side, so every row's date is honestly blank with needs_review=1; a year was never filled in from the report date. On the income side a single unlabelled column between Amount and Name is covered by the county's black bar on rows 1-10 and is visibly EMPTY on rows 11-12, so what that column held cannot be determined - recorded as redacted at source, never guessed, and nothing from it was written anywhere. donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. The income side also prints a payment-method word (Check / Online / Personal) that has no schema field; it is preserved in each row note rather than folded into donor_raw. FLAG CONFIRMED: the cover's signature Date line is BLANK (the signature itself is present); the clerk's RECEIVED IN OFFICE stamp reads JAN 31 2018, which is where index.csv's 2018-01-31 comes from - the form itself carries no filer date. Political Party cell holds a single letter 'D'. Office and Office Sought both read SLCO SHERIFF; District Number blank. ZERO-GLYPH RULING applied to Summary lines 3 and 7, both of which are slashed zeros; the verbatim glyph is kept in this note.
